gates.title: Gate 0 Freeze the experiment and remove stale assumptions
gates.scope_note: Historical v01 component pass preserved. A revised numerical update must repeat applicable mechanics and topology controls; not inherited physical cutting qualification.

gates.title: Gate 1 Establish trustworthy intact mechanics
gates.scope_note: Historical intact mechanics preserved. v09 GPU matches v07 integrated block forces and short trajectories at primary/half timesteps; no arbitrary tomato/contact qualification. v17 passes initial analytical, CPU/GPU, conservation and selected timestep controls in small linear-element blocks; no inherited tomato/contact qualification.

gates.title: Gate 2 Prove persistent cuts on a small block
gates.scope_note: v14 consistent local band and event-localized release passes short action/probe/timestep comparisons, including a faster held-out motion and loaded restart. Restricted single-plane band only. Spatial convergence, growing/moving band, arbitrary paths/full cut and Gate 2 as a whole remain unqualified. v16 local approximation fails oblique cut strain-rank checks; increasing uniform sampling did not resolve every case. No general-path pass. v17 removes the tested angled-cut rank defects and passes four geometric cut fixtures, bridge/independence/restart controls. These are prescribed geometry tests, not physical blade fracture or a finished Gate 2.

gates.title: Gate 3 Establish cutting resistance and reliable contact
gates.scope_note: Physical blade contact/reaction and irreversible fracture-work remain pending. v14 resolves the prior short-window update comparison in a restricted band but does not complete Gate 2 or establish a physical tomato cut.

gates.title: Gate 4 Build the reusable tomato and complete one slice
Gate 5 Verify freedom to change the cutting technique
Gate 6 Measure interactive and RL performance
gates.scope_note: v15 profiles unchanged v14 tiny block; fixed-topology dynamics already far below the project speed targets. This early no-go does not assert completion of physical prerequisites or a full Gate 6 RL benchmark. v16 bulk-only best 46.61 equivalent steps/s is below 100/s and excludes evolving cuts/contact. No complete environment or RL qualification. v17 first cost gate fails: 65.04/s at intact timestep, 8.27/s at corner-cut timestep, bulk only. History update overhead measured separately. No further candidate expansion.

gates.title: Gate 7 Connect the existing robot and verify resets
Gate 8 Prepare a small learning demonstration

runtime_qualification: v17 corrected linear-element mechanics passes component controls. Best tested intact bulk rate at the intact accuracy setting: 65.04 equivalent 50Hz steps/s. At the tested corner-cut accuracy timestep: 8.27/s. Both exclude history/contact/robot/policy; neither reaches 100/s. Geometric history updates add about 0.7s per body per event.
next_action: Stop this bounded candidate campaign. Preserve the mechanics correction. Any next speed strategy must address tiny-cut-region timesteps and history work explicitly, with a reviewed scope; do not automatically start another engine or physical tomato rollout.
